about: Every townsfolk favour in simulations/quests.mjs: the ask (<questId>) and each step (<questId>-<n>), said by the giver's designed voice. Written by tools/voice-cast/quest-lines.mjs.

bake-sugar: I'm out of sugar and the buns are waiting. Could you fetch some from the shop on the common?
teach-chalk: We have run out of chalk! Would you carry a box over from the noticeboard?
read-book: Someone left a book on a bench by the school. Could you bring it back before it rains?
post-letter: I'm late! Please take this letter to the café for me?
garden-seeds: The sunflowers need seeds. The school has a jar. Could you ask for it?
lab-sparkle: I lost my lucky magnifier! I think it is by the noticeboard. Can you look?
neighbour-bub: Bub has slipped his lead again. It will be on the common. Could you fetch it so I can catch him?
cafe-cup: A cup went missing from the café window. Could you look by the noticeboard?
farm-eggs: The hens have been busy and the baker is out of eggs. Could you find a warm one and take it to the café?
farm-eggs-0: Find an egg on the farm.
farm-pumpkin: The big orange pumpkins are ripe. Could you bring one to the common for the autumn display?
